key: CHARLOTTE: There you are.
en: CHARLOTTE: There you are.
ja: シャルロット: いたいた。

key: I heard the Doctor tried to stop you and fell flat on his face.
en: I heard the Doctor tried to stop you and fell flat on his face.
ja: ドクターが止めようとして、無様にすっ転んだって聞いたよ。

key: If I'd known that was gonna happen, I woulda stuck around to enjoy the show.
en: If I'd known that was gonna happen, I woulda stuck around to enjoy the show.
ja: そうなるってわかってたら、残って見物してたのに。

key: ...Anyway, business.
en: ...Anyway, business.
ja: ……まあいいや、本題に入ろう。

key: The police are going to be looking for us.
en: The police are going to be looking for us.
ja: 警察があたしたちを捜すはず。

key: They probably know we're going to try and escape the city, so the main exits are a no-go.
en: They probably know we're going to try and escape the city, so the main exits are a no-go.
ja: あたしたちが街から逃げようとするのはお見通しだろうから、正面の出口は使えない。

key: However, this tunnel runs underneath the city, and it comes out right in the Chrysolia Region.
en: However, this tunnel runs underneath the city, and it comes out right in the Chrysolia Region.
ja: でも、このトンネルは街の地下を通ってて、ちょうどクリソリア地方に出るんだ。

key: And it just so happens, that's where my sisters live now.
en: And it just so happens, that's where my sisters live now.
ja: それに都合よく、今あたしの姉妹たちが住んでるのもそこ。

key: We can lay low there until things cool down.
en: We can lay low there until things cool down.
ja: 事態が落ち着くまで、そこに身を潜めていられる。

key: The rest of the gang's already agreed.
en: The rest of the gang's already agreed.
ja: 他のみんなはもう賛成済み。

key: I just--
en: I just--
ja: あとは……

key: Need this stupid thing... to turn on already!
en: Need this stupid thing... to turn on already!
ja: このバカ機械を……さっさと起動させなきゃ!

key: CAIN: What's it for, anyway?
en: CAIN: What's it for, anyway?
ja: カイン: てか、それ何のためのやつ?

key: SHELLY: Um, I--
en: SHELLY: Um, I--
ja: シェリー: えっと、わ、私……

key: I think I know...
en: I think I know...
ja: なんとなく、わかるかも……

key: ...Why it's not turning on?
en: ...Why it's not turning on?
ja: ……どうして動かないのか。

key: If my guess is right, this is probably...
en: If my guess is right, this is probably...
ja: もし私の予想が正しければ、これはたぶん……

key: This is probably the basement of the old Yureyu Building...
en: This is probably the basement of the old Yureyu Building...
ja: これはたぶん、旧ユーレユビルの地下……

key: I read that they used to use it to import resources via the rail, so they had it run right through their HQ.
en: I read that they used to use it to import resources via the rail, so they had it run right through their HQ.
ja: 昔は資源を鉄道で運び込むのに使われてたって、本で読んだことがあって、それで本社の真下を通るように作られてたの。

key: They used to be the economic center of Reborn, but um, then...
en: They used to be the economic center of Reborn, but um, then...
ja: 昔はリボーンの経済の中心だったんだけど、その、それが……

key: Then earthquakes happened, and they were hit so hard they had to close.
en: Then earthquakes happened, and they were hit so hard they had to close.
ja: それから地震が起きて、大打撃を受けて、閉鎖せざるを得なくなったの。

key: They also managed the city's electricity at the time...
en: They also managed the city's electricity at the time...
ja: 当時は、街の電力も管理してたみたいで……

key: So that went down, too...
en: So that went down, too...
ja: だから、それも止まっちゃって……

key: And then the entire city shut down until the renaissance of the League.
en: And then the entire city shut down until the renaissance of the League.
ja: それで街全体が、リーグが復興するまでずっと止まったまま……

key: ...Right?
en: ...Right?
ja: ……だよね?

key: CHARLOTTE: ...And?
en: CHARLOTTE: ...And?
ja: シャルロット: ……それで?

key: NOEL: So then it won't open because it's connected to the old power plant, rather than the current operating one.
en: NOEL: So then it won't open because it's connected to the old power plant, rather than the current operating one.
ja: ノエル: つまり、今稼働してる発電所じゃなくて、昔の発電所につながってるから、開かないってわけだ。

key: ANNA: Old power plant?
en: ANNA: Old power plant?
ja: アンナ: 昔の発電所?

key: Wait a second!
en: Wait a second!
ja: ちょっと待って!

key: That's where Mr. Shadow lives!
en: That's where Mr. Shadow lives!
ja: そこ、シャドウさんが住んでるとこじゃん!

key: I bet if someone went up there and asked him to turn it back on, he would!
en: I bet if someone went up there and asked him to turn it back on, he would!
ja: 誰かが行って電源入れてってお願いしたら、きっとやってくれるよ!

key: SHELLY: W-wait, you mean Shade?
en: SHELLY: W-wait, you mean Shade?
ja: シェリー: ちょ、ちょっと待って、シェイドのこと?

key: We just saw him earlier too...
en: We just saw him earlier too...
ja: さっきも会ったばかりだけど……

key: He'd r-really listen to us...?
en: He'd r-really listen to us...?
ja: ほ、本当に、話を聞いてくれるのかな……?

key: ANNA: Who knows!
en: ANNA: Who knows!
ja: アンナ: さあね!

key: He's secretly super nice, though!
en: He's secretly super nice, though!
ja: でも、実は超いい人なんだよ!

key: It's a secret, so don't tell anyone!
en: It's a secret, so don't tell anyone!
ja: 秘密だから、誰にも言っちゃダメだよ!

key: NOEL: You've never spoken to him.
en: NOEL: You've never spoken to him.
ja: ノエル: 話したことすらないだろ。

key: How would you know whether he's nice or not?
en: How would you know whether he's nice or not?
ja: いい人かどうか、どうしてわかるんだよ。

key: ANNA: I just do!
en: ANNA: I just do!
ja: アンナ: わかるったらわかるの!

key: Hey, he's also a Reborn Gym Leader!
en: Hey, he's also a Reborn Gym Leader!
ja: ねえ、それに彼、リボーンのジムリーダーでもあるんだよ!

key: \PN, \PN, \PN!
en: \PN, \PN, \PN!
ja: \PN、\PN、\PN!

key: You should go up to the old Power Plant and ask Mr. Shadow to turn it back on and then fight him!
en: You should go up to the old Power Plant and ask Mr. Shadow to turn it back on and then fight him!
ja: 古い発電所に行って、シャドウさんに電源を入れてもらって、そのまま戦ってきなよ!

key: CAIN: Ohhh, that's the place across Beryl Bridge, right?
en: CAIN: Ohhh, that's the place across Beryl Bridge, right?
ja: カイン: ああ、ベリル橋の向こうにあるとこだろ?

key: ANNA: I'll have Nostra tell him to unlock the door, so go quickly, okay~?
en: ANNA: I'll have Nostra tell him to unlock the door, so go quickly, okay~?
ja: アンナ: ノストラに頼んでドアの鍵を開けてもらうから、早く行ってね~?

key: CHARLOTTE: You're really gonna go have \PN fight some guy in hopes that he'll be able to turn the power on here?
en: CHARLOTTE: You're really gonna go have \PN fight some guy in hopes that he'll be able to turn the power on here?
ja: シャルロット: ここの電源を入れてもらえるかもって理由だけで、\PNをどこかの誰かと戦わせるつもり?

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Sure, why not.
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Sure, why not.
ja: シャルロット: ……ま、いいんじゃない。

key: Better than any idea I have.
en: Better than any idea I have.
ja: あたしの考えるどんな案よりマシだし。

key: We'll probably be fine waiting here.
en: We'll probably be fine waiting here.
ja: ここで待ってても、たぶん大丈夫でしょ。

key: Go get 'em, chief.
en: Go get 'em, chief.
ja: 頑張ってきなよ、大将。

key: CHARLOTTE: We can't move forward until we get the power back here.
en: CHARLOTTE: We can't move forward until we get the power back here.
ja: シャルロット: こっちの電源が戻るまで、先には進めない。

key: Hurry up and kick Old Spooky's butt for us.
en: Hurry up and kick Old Spooky's butt for us.
ja: さっさとあの陰気な奴をボコしてきて。

key: ANNA: I like Cain, he's so nice, and pretty, too!
en: ANNA: I like Cain, he's so nice, and pretty, too!
ja: アンナ: カインのこと好きなんだ、優しいし、きれいだし!

key: And his eyes are pitch-black--
en: And his eyes are pitch-black--
ja: それに目が真っ黒でさ――

key: Isn't that so cool?!
en: Isn't that so cool?!
ja: かっこよくない?!

key: NOEL: Anna, his eyes aren't black.
en: NOEL: Anna, his eyes aren't black.
ja: ノエル: アンナ、あいつの目は黒くないよ。

key: ANNA: Yeah, they are!
en: ANNA: Yeah, they are!
ja: アンナ: 黒いもん!

key: They're like black holes into his soul~
en: They're like black holes into his soul~
ja: 魂に通じるブラックホールみたいなんだから~

key: NOEL: Sigh...
en: NOEL: Sigh...
ja: ノエル: はぁ……

key: ANNA: Isn't it weird that Heather still hasn't caught her breath yet?
en: ANNA: Isn't it weird that Heather still hasn't caught her breath yet?
ja: アンナ: ヘザー、まだ息切れが治ってないの、変じゃない?

key: We didn't run that far...
en: We didn't run that far...
ja: そんなに走ってないのに……

key: Does she have asthma or something?
en: Does she have asthma or something?
ja: ぜんそくか何かなのかな?

key: NOEL: She seems fine to me.
en: NOEL: She seems fine to me.
ja: ノエル: 僕には普通に見えるけど。

key: NOEL: It's nice to finally be out of that place.
en: NOEL: It's nice to finally be out of that place.
ja: ノエル: やっと、あそこから出られてよかった。

key: This is probably going to be an arduous journey though.
en: This is probably going to be an arduous journey though.
ja: でも、これから先は、きっと大変な旅になる。

key: NOEL: You should probably get going to the Power Plant before they catch us.
en: NOEL: You should probably get going to the Power Plant before they catch us.
ja: ノエル: 捕まる前に、発電所に向かった方がいいと思う。

key: ANNA: And to get your Gym Badge!
en: ANNA: And to get your Gym Badge!
ja: アンナ: それに、ジムバッジも手に入れなきゃ!

key: Yeah, yeah yeah yeah yeah yeah yeah yeah!
en: Yeah, yeah yeah yeah yeah yeah yeah yeah!
ja: そうそうそうそうそうそうそう!

key: CAIN: Sooo many obstacles!
en: CAIN: Sooo many obstacles!
ja: カイン: 障害物、めちゃくちゃ多いな!

key: Whatever~
en: Whatever~
ja: ま、いいか~

key: Even rocky roads make for fun traveling when you're in good company!
en: Even rocky roads make for fun traveling when you're in good company!
ja: 険しい道でも、いい仲間となら楽しい旅になるもんだぜ!

key: I'm pretty worried about Heather, but... at least she's safe.
en: I'm pretty worried about Heather, but... at least she's safe.
ja: ヘザーのことはかなり心配だけど……とりあえず無事ではある。

key: CAIN: That Power Plant is just across Beryl Bridge, up in the Beryl Ward.
en: CAIN: That Power Plant is just across Beryl Bridge, up in the Beryl Ward.
ja: カイン: あの発電所は、ベリル橋を渡った先の、ベリル地区にある。

key: I'm surprised that a girl from the orphanage knows that spooky Gym Leader though...
en: I'm surprised that a girl from the orphanage knows that spooky Gym Leader though...
ja: それにしても、孤児院育ちの子があの陰気なジムリーダーを知ってるとは驚きだな……

key: Even I really only heard about him through the grapevine.
en: Even I really only heard about him through the grapevine.
ja: オレだって、うわさで聞いたことがある程度なのに。

key: Buuut, I guess I wasn't exactly on the roster for that long, so maybe that's expected.
en: Buuut, I guess I wasn't exactly on the roster for that long, so maybe that's expected.
ja: まあ、オレもそんなに長く在籍してたわけじゃないし、当然っちゃ当然か。

key: SHELLY: Heather, why won't you say something?
en: SHELLY: Heather, why won't you say something?
ja: シェリー: ヘザー、どうして何も話してくれないの?

key: What's wrong?
en: What's wrong?
ja: どうしたの?

key: Please... talk to me?
en: Please... talk to me?
ja: お願い……何か話して?

key: SHELLY: I'm sorry if I made you mad, but um...
en: SHELLY: I'm sorry if I made you mad, but um...
ja: シェリー: 怒らせちゃったならごめんね、でも、その……

key: We'll get somewhere safer really soon, I promise...
en: We'll get somewhere safer really soon, I promise...
ja: もうすぐ、もっと安全な場所に行けるから、約束するよ……

key: Maybe then it'll be okay for you to talk?
en: Maybe then it'll be okay for you to talk?
ja: そしたら、話してくれてもいいかな?

key: HEATHER: ...
en: HEATHER: ...
ja: ヘザー: ……

key: ANNA: Ah! It opened! \PN did it!
en: ANNA: Ah! It opened! \PN did it!
ja: アンナ: あ! 開いた! \PNがやったんだ!

key: CHARLOTTE: Oh, we didn't even need this stupid machine.
en: CHARLOTTE: Oh, we didn't even need this stupid machine.
ja: シャルロット: あ、結局このバカ機械、要らなかったじゃん。

key: ???: It was about time.
en: ???: It was about time.
ja: ???: 遅かったな。

key: Greetings, all.
en: Greetings, all.
ja: 皆、ご機嫌よう。

key: CHARLOTTE: And just who are you?
en: CHARLOTTE: And just who are you?
ja: シャルロット: で、あんた誰?

key: ???: That's of no consequence to you.
en: ???: That's of no consequence to you.
ja: ???: お前には関係のないことだ。

key: Seize them.
en: Seize them.
ja: 捕らえろ。

key: ANNA: Ah!
en: ANNA: Ah!
ja: アンナ: あっ!

key: Cain, catch!
en: Cain, catch!
ja: カイン、キャッチ!

key: CAIN: What--?
en: CAIN: What--?
ja: カイン: な――?

key: ANNA: Just run!
en: ANNA: Just run!
ja: アンナ: とにかく走って!

key: CHARLOTTE: Hey, hands off of her!
en: CHARLOTTE: Hey, hands off of her!
ja: シャルロット: ちょっと、あの子から手を放せ!

key: ???: An interesting request.
en: ???: An interesting request.
ja: ???: 興味深い要求だ。

key: How about we talk about it inside?
en: How about we talk about it inside?
ja: 中で話そうじゃないか。

key: CAIN: Shoot-- Nidoking!
en: CAIN: Shoot-- Nidoking!
ja: カイン: くそ――ニドキング!

key: CAIN: Use Earthquake, now!
en: CAIN: Use Earthquake, now!
ja: カイン: じしんを使え、今すぐだ!

key: CAIN: Ugh... Let's bolt!
en: CAIN: Ugh... Let's bolt!
ja: カイン: うっ……逃げるぞ!

key: METEOR: Commander Sirius?
en: METEOR: Commander Sirius?
ja: メテオ団員: シリウス司令官?

key: SIRIUS: Let him go.
en: SIRIUS: Let him go.
ja: シリウス: そいつは放っておけ。

key: He's not part of our deal.
en: He's not part of our deal.
ja: 取引には関係ない。

key: We've got everything we need.
en: We've got everything we need.
ja: 必要なものはすべて手に入れた。

key: Exactly what the Doctor ordered.
en: Exactly what the Doctor ordered.
ja: まさに、ドクターの注文通りにな。

key: ???: Since when do men serve swine?
en: ???: Since when do men serve swine?
ja: ???: いつから、人間が豚に仕えるようになった?

key: SIRIUS: So nice of you to drop in, Private.
en: SIRIUS: So nice of you to drop in, Private.
ja: シリウス: よく来たな、兵卒。

key: ???: Agent.
en: ???: Agent.
ja: ???: エージェントだ。

key: SIRIUS: You were promoted, then.
en: SIRIUS: You were promoted, then.
ja: シリウス: 昇進したか。

key: That is... awfully quick.
en: That is... awfully quick.
ja: それは……ずいぶん早いな。

key: ???: A spot was vacant, after all.
en: ???: A spot was vacant, after all.
ja: ???: 席が空いたのでな。

key: SIRIUS: Ah... Borealis.
en: SIRIUS: Ah... Borealis.
ja: シリウス: ああ……ボレアリスか。

key: I had hoped to wring his neck myself.
en: I had hoped to wring his neck myself.
ja: 奴の首は、自分の手で締めたかったのだがな。

key: ???: A new Systems Manager has also been chosen.
en: ???: A new Systems Manager has also been chosen.
ja: ???: 新たなシステムマネージャーも選ばれた。

key: SIRIUS: So I heard, after what happened with Ace.
en: SIRIUS: So I heard, after what happened with Ace.
ja: シリウス: エースの件のあとで、そう聞いたな。

key: ???: You would do well to mind your new company.
en: ???: You would do well to mind your new company.
ja: ???: 新しい仲間には気をつけることだ。

key: SIRIUS: You would do well to mind your manners.
en: SIRIUS: You would do well to mind your manners.
ja: シリウス: 口の利き方には気をつけることだ。

key: Promotion or not, I am still your commanding officer.
en: Promotion or not, I am still your commanding officer.
ja: 昇進しようがしまいが、私はまだお前の上官だぞ。

key: ???: In title.
en: ???: In title.
ja: ???: 肩書き上はな。

key: SIRIUS: And just what does that mean?
en: SIRIUS: And just what does that mean?
ja: シリウス: それはどういう意味だ?

key: ???: Titles are meaningless.
en: ???: Titles are meaningless.
ja: ???: 肩書きなど、意味を持たない。

key: Results are what matter.
en: Results are what matter.
ja: 大切なのは結果だ。

key: SIRIUS: Did you come here solely to tell me things I already know?
en: SIRIUS: Did you come here solely to tell me things I already know?
ja: シリウス: わざわざここまで来て、知っていることを言いに来たのか?

key: I came to deliver a warning.
en: I came to deliver a warning.
ja: 警告を届けに来た。

key: Know your place,
en: Know your place,
ja: 己の分をわきまえろ、

key: Or it will make itself known to you.
en: Or it will make itself known to you.
ja: さもなくば、それを思い知ることになる。

key: SIRIUS: Impudent wench.
en: SIRIUS: Impudent wench.
ja: シリウス: 生意気な小娘め。

key: SIRIUS: Well, don't just stand there gawking.
en: SIRIUS: Well, don't just stand there gawking.
ja: シリウス: さて、ぼさっと突っ立ってないで。

key: There's work to be done.
en: There's work to be done.
ja: やるべきことがある。

key: METEOR: Y-yes, sir!
en: METEOR: Y-yes, sir!
ja: メテオ団員: は、はい!
